protocol.cold: mincore 0, open and advice outside the clock
protocol.materialized: positions, cell, masses, atomic numbers, constraints, velocities as numpy arrays, inside the clock, both tools
protocol.read_path: RCSO copy, CON text parsed only when the cooked blocks are absent
protocol.short_read: a read shorter than 50 ms repeats until the timed spans add to 50 ms
protocol.short_insert: a commit shorter than 2 s repeats until the timed spans add to 2 s
protocol.peak_rss: one fresh process per row, VmHWM of that process
